applicationFee.note: First graduate application is free. Subsequent applications cost $40 domestic/$50 international.

english.note: Doctoral students must meet published minimum. Waiver categories include a qualifying US study period or degree from US/listed countries; English-medium education alone is not a universal exemption.

documents: Personal statement (2025 department guidance specifies two pages)
Three recommendation letters; list three potential faculty mentors in order of preference
requirements.note: Bachelor’s degree and GPA3.0 required. Advisor must agree to accept the applicant before committee review. Current degree page says no GRE; older2025 admissions PDF still requests GRE for non-US graduates, so the current no-GRE statement is used and the inconsistency should be confirmed.

funding.note: 2025 department guidance: research students need documented independent/RA support or a TA request for acceptance. All admitted students are eligible for TA support but availability is not guaranteed; RA support is at the investigator’s discretion.
